description:
Create a new blank Clueso project. Returns the projectId and initialClipId — the project starts with one blank clip already at index 0 (default short duration). Use update_clips to resize/retitle clip 0, add_clips(kind='blank') to append more clips, add_elements to place content, and add_audio to attach a project-level music track.

Optionally place the project inside a folder (use find(type='folders') to find folder IDs, or create_folder to make one) and set a description at creation time.

Start it voiced (one or the other):
  • script — one blank clip per paragraph (blank-line separated), each with AI voiceover generated from it; clip lengths follow the speech (generation runs in the background, ~seconds per clip). Returns clip_ids.
  • audio — an audio upload (an mcp_upload_id or a Clueso upload_id): it becomes clip 0's voiceover as the original narration, transcribed (script + captions), and the clip takes its length. Returns duration and word_count.

audio.description: An audio upload (an mcp_upload_id or a Clueso upload_id) to use as the voiceover (original narration, transcribed). Not with `script`.

folder_id.description: Optional folder ID to nest the project under. Use find(type='folders') to discover IDs. Omit to create at workspace root.

script.description: Voiceover script; one blank clip per paragraph. Not with `audio`.

name: create_project
title: Create project
